content.json:
## SOC L2 Lab — Eventos de seguridad generados
Visualiza la actividad benigna marcada `SOC-L2-Pxx` que produce `Invoke-SocLabLogGeneration.ps1`. Usa el selector de tiempo para ajustar la ventana. Cada panel corresponde a una prueba de la guía de cobertura.
### Resumen de marcadores SOC-L2 por tabla

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventID == 4625 and TargetUserName startswith 'soc-l2-p02'
| summarize Intentos = count(), Primero = min(TimeGenerated), Ultimo = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer, TargetUserName, LogonType, Status, SubStatus, IpAddress
| sort by Intentos desc

content.json: ### P15 — Ciclo de vida de cuentas y grupos de dominio

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventID in (4720, 4722, 4723, 4724, 4725, 4726, 4727, 4728, 4729, 4730, 4732, 4733, 4738, 4767, 4776)
| where TargetUserName startswith 'SOCp15' or TargetUserName startswith 'SOCg15' or MemberName has 'SOCp15' or TargetAccount has 'SOCp15'
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, MemberName
| sort by TimeGenerated asc

content.json: ### P03 — Creación de procesos con marcador (4688)

content.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventID == 4688 and CommandLine has 'SOC-L2-P03'
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

content.json: ### P04 y P04B — Linux Syslog y accesos SSH/su fallidos

content.query:
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where SyslogMessage has 'SOC-L2-P04' or (ProcessName in ('sshd','su') and SyslogMessage has 'socp04')
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Facility, SeverityLevel, ProcessName, SyslogMessage
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

content.json: ### P05 — Peticiones tipo escáner a App Service

content.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where UserAgent startswith 'SOC-L2-Lab'
| summarize Peticiones = count() by CsMethod, ScStatus, CsUriStem, CIp
| sort by Peticiones desc

content.json: ### P11 y P12 — Servidores web Apache (local6) e IIS (W3CIISLog)

content.query:
AZKVAuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where OperationName has 'Secret' or RequestUri has 'soc-l2-p07'
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, ResultType, ResultSignature, HttpStatusCode, CallerIpAddress, RequestUri
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

content.json: ### P08 y P10 — Actividad en AKS (auditoría admin y eventos)

content.query:
AKSAuditAdmin
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where RequestUri has 'soc-l2-p08'
| project TimeGenerated, Verb, RequestUri, Decision = tostring(parse_json(tostring(ResponseStatus)).code), Usuario = tostring(parse_json(tostring(User)).username)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

KubeEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Namespace startswith 'soc-l2-p08' or Message has 'soc-l2-p10'
| project TimeGenerated, Namespace, Name, Reason, Message, KubeEventType
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

content.json: ### Incidentes generados por las reglas LAB-Pxx

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Title startswith 'LAB-'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Status, Severity, Owner) by IncidentNumber, Title
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Owner
| sort by IncidentNumber desc
